name: ReviewX – Multi-Criteria Reviews for WooCommerce with Google Reviews & Schema
author: ReviewX

sections.description:
ReviewX turns happy customers into your best salespeople. Collect detailed, multi-criteria reviews with photos, ask for them after every order, reward reviewers with a discount and show it all in a fast, beautiful review section that matches your theme, in light and in dark mode. It works for WooCommerce products and for any WordPress post type: courses, listings, services, recipes, events and more.

ReviewX the No.1 review plugin for WordPress and WooCommerce. Version 3 is a ground-up rebuild with: a new admin, a new storefront, ReviewX Cloud behind it, and every screen designed to get you more reviews with less work.

Website | Documentation | Pricing | Changelog

✨ What’s new in ReviewX 3

  • Rebuilt admin. A new design system across every screen, responsive down to a phone, with its own light and dark theme.
  • Rebuilt storefront. The reviews section, review form, shortcodes, blocks and My Account form share one design: responsive, right-to-left ready, keyboard accessible and lighter, because the assets load only on pages that show reviews.
  • Light & dark mode that follows your theme. Reviews turn dark on dark pages and switch live when a visitor toggles your theme’s dark mode. ReviewX recognises the usual dark mode classes and attributes and the page background, you can add your theme’s own marker, and every post type, shortcode, block and widget can also stay always light or always dark.
  • Settings for every post type. Widget settings and Appearance → Customize → ReviewX keep a look per post type: products are the default, other post types inherit it or get their own. The Customizer offers 147 options with a live preview.
  • Shortcode Designer. Pick any ReviewX shortcode, set it up with plain options and watch a live preview with sample reviews on desktop and mobile, on a light or a dark page. Copy it as a shortcode or as a PHP template line.
  • Blocks and builders. Gutenberg blocks with live previews in the editor, Elementor widgets, classic widgets, and shortcodes for Divi, Oxygen and any other builder.
  • Tools that keep your data clean. Data sync with history, cache management, and a cleanup tool that finds duplicate reviews and reviews left behind in the cloud.
  • ReviewX Cloud dashboard. See every connected store in one place, with store insights that tell you what to do next.

🚀 Why store owners choose ReviewX

  • More reviews, on autopilot. Review request emails, follow-ups and discounts for reviews bring in the feedback most customers forget to leave.
  • More trust, more sales. Verified buyer badges, a recommendation score, photos and videos show new shoppers what real customers think.
  • Better SEO. Review rich snippets can show your star rating in Google search results.
  • Real insight. Multi-criteria ratings show which part of a product delights customers and which part needs work.
  • Fits your store. Any theme, any post type, any page builder, in your colours and your language.

🆓 Free features

  • Multi-criteria ratings: let customers rate what matters, such as quality, value or fit (2 criteria on the free plan).
  • Photo reviews: customers add photos to their reviews.
  • Review request emails: ask customers for a review after their order, one by one or in bulk, with test emails and email logs. Includes 20 emails a month through ReviewX, or unlimited with your own SMTP server.
  • Reviews based on order status: choose the order statuses that allow a review.
  • Discounts for reviews: reward reviewers with a WooCommerce coupon.
  • Google rich snippets: review schema so search engines can show your star ratings.
  • Rating summary and charts: average, star distribution, criteria bars and recommendation score.
  • Customizable layouts: grid, list or masonry, your brand and star colours, and light and dark mode.
  • Review filters for shoppers: filter by rating and media, sort by date or rating.
  • Verified buyer badge and recommendations.
  • Google reviews: show your Google Business reviews on your site.
  • Reviews on any post type: not only products.
  • All reviews in one place: manage, approve, trash and filter reviews by post type.
  • reCAPTCHA spam protection and a consent checkbox for GDPR.
  • Reviewer profile photos and review submission without a page reload.
  • Page builders: Gutenberg blocks, Elementor, Divi and Oxygen.
  • Translation ready: WPML and Loco Translate.

💎 Pro and Agency plans

Upgrade when you are ready for the full toolkit. Pro covers one store; Agency plans cover 5 or 50 stores from one dashboard. See plans and pricing.

  • Up to 10 rating criteria per post type.
  • Video reviews and anonymous reviews.
  • Automatic review reminders with follow-up and photo request emails, smart timing and more emails each month.
  • Reply to reviews with your logo, edit and moderate reviews, approval rules and review limits per customer.
  • Highlight your best reviews and let shoppers vote on helpful reviews.
  • Stars, thumbs or emoji rating styles.
  • Share reviews on social media.
  • Add reviews manually and import reviews from CSV and other tools.
  • Instant alerts for new reviews and your logo in review emails.
  • Agency: multi-store license manager, CSV import and export, white-label branding and priority support.

🧩 Shortcodes

Build any of them visually in ReviewX → Shortcodes, or see the shortcode guide. Every shortcode also takes theme="auto", theme="light" or theme="dark".

  • [rvx-woo-reviews] the complete reviews section for the current product.
  • [rvx-review-form] rating summary, filters, review list and review form for one product or post.
  • [rvx-review-list] a review feed for the whole store, one post type or a single item.
  • [rvx-reviews review_ids="12,57"] hand-picked reviews.
  • [rvx-summary], [rvx-criteria-graph] and [rvx-stats] rating summaries and graphs.
  • [rvx-star-count] a compact star rating for product grids and titles.
  • [rvx-google-review] your Google reviews.

☁️ How ReviewX works

ReviewX connects your site to ReviewX Cloud, which sends review emails, creates discount codes, prepares insights and keeps your rating numbers fast. Your reviews stay in WordPress as well, so they remain yours if you ever stop using ReviewX. Connecting takes a minute: activate the plugin, create a free account or log in, and ReviewX syncs your products and existing reviews.

🤝 Support and community

  • Documentation and video tutorials.
  • Support forum and contact us.
  • Enjoying ReviewX? A review on WordPress.org helps other store owners find it.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins → Add New, search for ReviewX and click Install Now, then Activate. Or upload the reviewx.zip file under Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Open ReviewX in the admin menu and create your free ReviewX Cloud account or log in. Your products and existing reviews sync automatically.
  3. Set up your review criteria in ReviewX → Reviews → Review settings, choose the look in Widget settings, and turn on review emails in ReviewX → Review Reminder.
sections.faq:
Is ReviewX free?

Yes. The free plan covers one store and includes multi-criteria ratings, photo reviews, review request emails, discounts for reviews, Google rich snippets, reviews on any post type and every page builder integration. Pro and Agency plans add more criteria, video reviews, automatic reminders, moderation tools and more stores.

Do I need WooCommerce?

No. With WooCommerce, ReviewX replaces the product reviews tab and can send review emails after orders. Without it, ReviewX adds reviews to any post type you choose.

What happens to my existing WooCommerce reviews?

They sync to ReviewX automatically when you connect, with their ratings. Earlier reviews have no criteria ratings, because they were written before you used ReviewX.

Does ReviewX work with my theme?

Yes. The reviews section uses its own styles, follows your theme’s light and dark mode and can take your brand colours. If your theme marks its dark mode in an unusual way, enter that class or attribute in Widget settings → Match the theme’s light and dark mode.

Can I show reviews outside the product page?

Yes. Use the Gutenberg blocks, the Elementor widgets, the classic widgets or any shortcode. ReviewX → Shortcodes builds the shortcode for you with a live preview.

How many review emails can I send?

The free plan includes 20 emails a month through ReviewX and paid plans 200. Connect your own SMTP server in ReviewX → Settings to send without a monthly limit.

Does ReviewX slow down my site?

No. Its scripts and styles load only on pages that show reviews, and rating summaries are cached. ReviewX also clears the common page caches when reviews or settings change.

Is ReviewX GDPR friendly?

You can add a consent checkbox to the review form, and reviewers can review anonymously on paid plans. See External services above for the data ReviewX Cloud processes.

What happens if I uninstall ReviewX?

Your reviews stay in WordPress as regular WooCommerce or WordPress reviews. Only the criteria ratings and ReviewX features are no longer shown.

Can I translate ReviewX?

Yes. ReviewX is translation ready and works with WPML and Loco Translate.
sections.changelog:
3.0.1 – 11-08-2026

  • Complete ReviewX admin redesigned from scratch: new design system, fully responsive on every screen size.
  • Storefront reviews widget, review form, shortcodes, blocks and My Account form redesigned on the same design system: responsive, RTL-ready, keyboard accessible, lighter (assets load only on pages that show reviews).
  • Widget settings preview now shows the real storefront widget live while you edit.
  • Review list shortcode/block/widget: new rating summary & graph (graph=”on”) and reviewed-product link (product=”on”); new Elementor “ReviewX Review List” widget; Gutenberg blocks now appear in the inserter with live previews.
  • Review submission rules (verified buyers, one review per customer, media types, consent) are enforced server-side; logged-in shoppers are recognised correctly when submitting.
  • Fixed like/dislike buttons duplicating, video-only uploads being dropped, stale Customizer styles overriding the design, and the Google Reviews shortcode rendering unescaped content.
  • Fixed Google reCAPTCHA (v2 and v3) on the storefront review form; verification now enforced server-side.
  • Fixed shop logo in customer email headers (Review Reminder, Discount for Review) and admin notification emails.
  • Fixed “Reviews per page” setting not applied on the storefront.
  • New recommendation bar on product pages and shortcodes, with live preview in widget settings.
  • Fixed test emails for Review Reminder, Discount for Review and Thank You templates.
  • Fixed backslashes disappearing from review text, titles and replies edited from ReviewX Cloud, and backslashes appearing in cached storefront reviews on the second page load.
  • Fixed product names showing HTML entities (e.g. “&”, “–”) in the reviews list and ReviewX Cloud.
  • Appearance → Customize → ReviewX rebuilt: per post type (Product is the default, others inherit or get their own look), working live preview, 147 options (brand/star colours, fonts, radius, cards, bars, replies, media, inputs, buttons, pop-ups…), values kept across theme switches and backed up to ReviewX Cloud.
  • New Shortcodes screen: pick any ReviewX shortcode, set it up with plain options, watch a live preview built from the real storefront with sample reviews, and copy the result as a shortcode or as a PHP template line.
  • Appearance -> Customize -> ReviewX: every section has a “Reset to default” button, and the Post type section can reset all of them at once.
  • “ReviewX at a glance” on the WordPress dashboard fills its stars to the exact average, so 4.44 no longer looks like 4.
  • Discount for review: the include and exclude product lists are easier to read and to use, with searchable rows, thumbnails, product IDs and removable chips.
  • Dark mode: the date picker’s month and year navigator and the text on primary buttons are readable again.
  • Storefront: the dislike button shows a thumbs-down, “Allow like & dislike” shows both buttons, and pop-up, menu and toast animations play as designed.
  • Reviews: deleting a reply no longer reports an error after it succeeded, and the list no longer shows a stale copy right after a change reaches ReviewX Cloud.
  • Custom post types can be created again, and a refusal from ReviewX Cloud is reported instead of being announced as success.
  • Upgrading from an earlier version runs one full sync, so reviews, reviewers and orders already in your shop pick up this release’s fixes.
  • The sync overlay trusts the shop’s saved state on first load instead of asking again.
  • Fixed a PHP warning written to the debug log every time the Google reviews shortcode rendered.
  • [rvx-star-count] shows no heading again unless you pass title=”true”, the way 2.5.x behaved.
  • The plugin is quiet in the PHP error log unless WP_DEBUG_LOG is on, and its output, translator comments and packaging follow the WordPress plugin guidelines.
  • New: storefront reviews follow your theme’s light and dark mode. ReviewX recognises the usual dark mode classes and attributes (such as .dark, .dark-mode, data-theme=”dark”, data-bs-theme and popular dark mode plugins), the page’s color-scheme and the background behind the widget, and switches live when visitors toggle the theme.
  • New: themes with their own dark mode marker can be matched exactly: enter its class, ID or attribute as a CSS selector in Reviews → Widget settings or Appearance → Customize → ReviewX → Light & dark mode.
  • New: light and dark mode per post type, stored in ReviewX Cloud with the other widget settings: match the theme, always light or always dark, set in Reviews → Widget settings or the Customizer, which also gives every colour option its own dark colour. Reviews kept light on a dark page (or dark on a light one) bring their own background, so they stay readable.
  • New: every shortcode takes theme=”auto”, “light” or “dark”; left out, it follows the post type’s setting (match the theme by default). The Shortcodes screen, every ReviewX block, classic widget and Elementor widget offer it as “Light / dark mode”.
  • New: Widget settings and Shortcodes previews can show a light or a dark theme page, and “Desktop” now shows the real desktop layout, scaled to fit.
  • Fixed: the My Account “Add review” button could stop opening the review form once dark mode detection ran.
  • New: post type filter on the Reviews page. “All reviews” is the default; pick a post type to narrow the list, the tabs and the rating summary.
  • New: Tools → Duplicate & orphan reviews finds reviews left in ReviewX Cloud after their WordPress review was deleted, and lets you remove them one by one or all at once.
  • Fixed: a review that could not be saved in WordPress no longer reaches ReviewX Cloud, so it cannot turn into an orphan or skew product ratings.
  • Fixed minor issues.
